# NumSys — Number System Converter

> Free browser-based converter for Indian (lakh, crore, arab, kharab, neel, padma, shankh)
> and International (thousand, million, billion, trillion, quadrillion) number naming,
> plus binary, octal, decimal, hexadecimal and base 2–36 conversion with the working shown.
> Everything runs client-side; no conversion data is transmitted or stored.

## Core tools

- [Number System Converter](https://numbersystemconverter.com/): Convert between Indian and International number systems with full word expansion, plus a base converter with steps.
- [Base Converter Calculator](https://numbersystemconverter.com/knowledge-catalog/base-converter-calculator/): Convert any base from 2 to 36, including fractions, with positional expansion and repeated division shown.
- [Converter With Steps](https://numbersystemconverter.com/knowledge-catalog/number-system-converter-with-steps/): Worked step-by-step solutions for decimal, binary, octal and hexadecimal conversion.
- [Calculator With Solution](https://numbersystemconverter.com/knowledge-catalog/number-system-conversion-calculator-with-solution/): Full solution format, including fractional conversion and naming-scale conversions.
- [Conversion Table](https://numbersystemconverter.com/knowledge-catalog/number-system-conversion-table/): 0–255 in decimal, binary, octal and hexadecimal, powers of two, and Indian vs International scales.
- [Conversion PDF](https://numbersystemconverter.com/knowledge-catalog/number-system-conversion-pdf/): Free two-page printable chart.

## Reference

- [Knowledge Catalog](https://numbersystemconverter.com/knowledge-catalog/): Everything in one place — utility, use cases, quick education, audience, FAQ and guides.
- [About](https://numbersystemconverter.com/about/): What the site does and how it is built.
- [Contact](https://numbersystemconverter.com/contact/): Report a conversion error or broken page.

## Key facts

- 1 million = 10 lakh; 1 billion = 1 arab = 100 crore; 1 trillion = 1 lakh crore.
- Indian scale: lakh 10^5, crore 10^7, arab 10^9, kharab 10^11, neel 10^13, padma 10^15, shankh 10^17.
- Portuguese (Portugal) uses the long scale: bilião = 10^12. Brazilian Portuguese uses the short scale: bilhão = 10^9.
- Spanish billón = 10^12; English billion = mil millones = 10^9.
- French milliard, German Milliarde, Dutch miljard, Italian miliardo = 10^9.
- Japanese, Chinese and Korean group in fours: 万 = 10^4, 億 = 10^8, 兆 = 10^12.
- 255 = 11111111 (binary) = 377 (octal) = FF (hex).
